changes.summary: Terminology only: "This card can only be Special Summoned from your Fusion Deck" becomes "... from your Extra Deck" when the TCG renamed the zone. The Fusion procedure, the discard-to-negate effect and the either-player's-turn clause are untouched.

effective.basis: TCG release of the first printing carrying the errata'd text (LCGX-EN253, Legendary Collection 2: The Duel Academy Years Mega Pack)

changes.historical_text: "Gladiator Beast Laquari" + 2 "Gladiator Beast" monstersThis card can only be Special Summoned from your Extra Deck, by returning the above cards you control to the Deck. (You do not use "Polymerization".) You can discard 1 card from your hand to negate the activation of a Spell or Trap Card and destroy it. You can use this effect during either player's turn.
changes.modern_text: "Gladiator Beast Laquari" + 2 "Gladiator Beast" monstersMust first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by shuffling the above cards you control into the Deck. (You do not use "Polymerization".) During either player's turn, when a Spell/Trap Card is activated: You can discard 1 card; negate the activation and destroy it. This card must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect.
changes.summary: Functional erratum: the era text is a strict nomi - "This card can only be Special Summoned from your Extra Deck, by returning the above cards you control to the Deck" - so a Heraklinos that has left the field can never be brought back by any other Special Summon. The errata'd text is semi-nomi, "Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by shuffling the above cards you control into the Deck", so once it has been properly Fusion Summoned the modern card may afterwards be Special Summoned from the Graveyard by generic revival. The same revision recasts the negation into PSCT ("When a Spell/Trap Card is activated: You can discard 1 card; negate the activation and destroy it") and adds "This card must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect", which codify the existing Quick Effect behaviour rather than change it.

gap.reason: Project Ignis ships no historical implementation of this card; reproducing the era behaviour needs a custom script and a reserved passcode
gap.behavioural_impact: In an Edison snapshot EDOPro lets a Heraklinos sitting in the Graveyard be revived by Monster Reborn, Call of the Haunted or Escape from the Dark Dimension after a proper Fusion Summon, a line the era's "can only be Special Summoned from your Extra Deck" text makes illegal - a material difference for a top-tier Edison Gladiator Beast deck.

review.notes: upstream_implementations is empty; no goat or pre-errata variant of 27346636 exists upstream. Edison (2010-04-24) falls on v1 (TDGS-ENSE2, 2008-10-07); the erratum lands 2011-10-04, well after. Trailing cosmetic revision v2 -> v3 (MZTM-EN084, 2025-03-13: "(Quick Effect)" tag and "negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it") is not recorded as a change. Evidence discrepancy noted: the pinned cards.cdb text retains the reminder "(You do not use "Polymerization".)" but the lineage's v3 clean text omits it (modern_text_matches_version index 3, ratio 0.9528, not exact); every earlier lineage version carries the reminder, and it is a non-behavioural reminder line, so this reads as a Yugipedia text-extraction artifact rather than a real text event. Heraklinos does not appear on the EdisonFormat.com Functional Errata list.
